conda_only_dependency.name: python-mumps
conda_only_dependency.pypi_status: sdist only (python_mumps-0.0.6.tar.gz), NO wheel for any platform -- needs the compiled MUMPS/SCOTCH/METIS C/Fortran libraries at build time, which pip cannot provide
conda_only_dependency.conda_forge_status: wheel-equivalent .conda packages exist for osx-arm64, osx-64, linux-64, linux-aarch64, linux-ppc64le, win-64
conda_only_dependency.resolution_used_in_this_spike: micromamba (2.9.0) into a throwaway env (mm/mumbaenv), then the compiled extension + its 21-dylib transitive closure copied into the pip runtime and relinked with install_name_tool (see graft_mumps.sh) so every @rpath reference resolves via @loader_path instead of the conda prefix

upstream_wheel_defect_worked_around.symptom: ImportError: Library not loaded: @rpath/libmpfr.6.dylib -- LC_RPATH baked into the wheel at build time is the SimNIBS developer's own absolute path (/Users/axelt/miniforge3/envs/simnibs_dev/lib), not relocatable
upstream_wheel_defect_worked_around.resolution_used_in_this_spike: libmpfr.6.dylib + libgmp.10.dylib obtained from conda-forge (mpfr=4.2.1, same pin environment_macos.yml lists) via micromamba, copied in, install_name_tool -add_rpath pointing the 3 extensions at the new location plus /usr/lib (libc++.1.dylib and libz.1.dylib are system libraries, resolved once /usr/lib is an explicit rpath entry -- @rpath lookups do not fall back to /usr/lib on their own)
